chapter_meta_description: The Heart-Turbid manifests! Li Huowang must use his own flesh and bone to link his pain to his enemy's in a terrifying display of tactical body horror. Will it be enough?
og_title: Daoguixian Ch. 355: A Battle of Pain and Erasure
og_description: Faced with an enemy who can hide everything, Li Huowang resorts to a gruesome solution: linking their pains through self-mutilation. A tactical masterpiece of body horror.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Xian Ch. 355: The Heart-Turbid Appears
twitter_description: Li Huowang breaks his own ribs to create a pain-link with the elusive Heart-Turbid. The most visceral battle yet!

lore_anchors.definition: A type of twisted entity or cultivator whose ability is to "hide" or "erase" concepts, objects, or memories from existence. A counterpart to the Heart-Element.
A ritual Daoist weapon made from coins strung on red cord; can be used as both a solid sword and a segmented whip.
A high-ranking eunuch official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; their power is both bureaucratic and supernatural, often wielded through a deceptively genial demeanor.
A group of legendary xian (immortals) in Chinese mythology, often invoked in religious and ritual contexts for exorcism and protection.
